Domestic supply evidence could not be established: DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection refused on both attempts, narasus.com failed with TLS error, and zaubacorp/thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403, so GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report India/export splits are null — not public in accessible sources, not invented. Domestic status therefore 'unknown', not 'none_found': absence of accessible evidence is not proof of absence of domestic sales. No sanctions/court/owner issues assessed here (out of scope for this role).
